products.name: Krita AI
products.note: Open-source digital art; local AI plugins; no cloud dependency; community governance

profile_text.body:
The Krita Foundation is a nonprofit, open-source foundation that develops and maintains Krita, a digital painting and image editing application distributed freely to artists and creators. The foundation describes its work as community-governed, with development driven by contributors rather than commercial interests, and the software carries no cloud dependency for its core functionality.

On the AI side, the foundation offers what the site tracks as Krita AI, an open-source digital art tool that supports local AI plugins, meaning any AI-assisted features run on the user's own hardware rather than through external cloud services. This approach reflects the foundation's emphasis on user autonomy and community governance over centralized, subscription-based models.

No litigation, SEC filings, MCP server registrations, or patent records appear in the available data for the Krita Foundation.
